title: Reception of an RRCReconfigurationFailureSidelink by the UE

entities.name: RRCReconfigurationFailureSidelink
entities.description: Message received by UE indicating failure of sidelink reconfiguration procedure.

entities.name: Timer T400
entities.description: Timer associated with sidelink reconfiguration procedure for a specific destination.

entities.name: RRC_CONNECTED
entities.description: RRC state where UE has an active connection with the network.

entities.name: sidelink UE information for NR sidelink communication procedure
entities.description: Procedure where UE provides sidelink capability and configuration information to the network.
provenance: References TS 38.331 Clause 5.8.3.3 and TS 36.331 Clause 5.10.15

entities.name: UE is in RRC_CONNECTED
entities.description: Condition checking if UE is currently in RRC_CONNECTED state.

entities.name: continue using previous configuration
entities.description: UE continues using the configuration that was active prior to the corresponding RRCReconfigurationSidelink message.

relations.description: Reception of RRCReconfigurationFailureSidelink stops timer T400 for the destination if running.
Reception of RRCReconfigurationFailureSidelink causes UE to continue using previous configuration.
Reception of RRCReconfigurationFailureSidelink triggers conditional execution based on UE RRC state.
Condition requires UE to be in RRC_CONNECTED state.
When UE is in RRC_CONNECTED state, sidelink UE information procedure is performed.
